title: [LOCAL] gflib-build: builder3-first orchestration + zero-setup pinned toolchain provisioning (fontc + gftools-builder3)
description: Make gftools-builder3 the always-preferred orchestrator with per-family graceful fallback (builder3→builder2+fontc→builder2+fontmake), and make both fontc and builder3 guaranteed-available with zero user setup via a pinned auto-provisioner (new rust/src/toolchain.rs: clone pinned rev into <data-dir>/tools, cargo build --locked, marker files, ready-gates, pipeline TaskItems). Literal cargo deps rejected: fontc is binary-only (no lib target); builder3 has 8 git deps (unpublishable, ~3600-package closure). Plan approved 2026-06-12: ~/.claude/plans/mighty-inventing-whistle.md
notes: UPDATE 2026-06-12 (2): auto-upgrade landed (gflib-build d4b7ced): built-below-top-rung families re-attempted automatically once per pins_sig, queued last; declined upgrades restore record+binaries verbatim; successful upgrades keep superseded binaries under build-dir/variants/<slug>/<builder>-<backend>/ for M3 comparison. E2E-verified both ways in /tmp smoke. Also: builder3 logger fix committed locally on branch fix-logger-double-init (9b35f4c) in ~/compartilhado/gftools-builder3 + PR draft at gftools-builder3-analysis/pr-draft-logger-fix.md (Felipe pushes). 81 tests green. Still pending: host-side provisioning validation + push.

title: Lilex + Grandstander config fixes, drift investigation, prepare google/fonts PR
description: Per Felipe's direction: fix Lilex config_yaml (sources/Lilex/config.yaml -> sources/config.yaml); Grandstander option A (add override config.yaml + remove config_yaml from METADATA.pb); investigate 8 drift cases (EB Garamond, Geist, Geist Mono, Grenze, Mingzat, Zalando Sans/Expanded/SemiExpanded); prepare google/fonts PR for review.

title: Fix METADATA.pb for Red Hat fonts (bghryct/* → RedHatOfficial/RedHatFont)
description: The 3 Red Hat font families (RedHatDisplay, RedHatMono, RedHatText) have METADATA.pb source blocks pointing to deleted repos (bghryct/RedHatDisplay, bghryct/RedHatMono, bghryct/RedHatText — all 404). The correct current repo is RedHatOfficial/RedHatFont (a monorepo). The old commit hashes do not exist in the new repo — it was recreated, not transferred. Needs: (1) find the correct commit in RedHatOfficial/RedHatFont matching the fonts shipped in google/fonts, (2) update repository_url for all 3 families, (3) update files mappings for the monorepo structure, (4) write upstream_info.md. Then submit a PR to google/fonts.

title: Improve fontc_crater data handling and classification
description: Dashboard crater-coverage tab currently uses only results/sources.json to determine coverage. This misses two other upstream inputs: targets.json (intended targets declared via PRs) and results/failed_repos.json (target resolution failures). Update fetch_crater_analysis.py to fetch and index all four inputs; update js/main.js classifyMissingFamily to differentiate: (1) not submitted upstream, (2) target resolution failed upstream (surface reason inline), (3) submitted but not in latest run, (4) upstream metadata drift (rev/config path mismatches with our METADATA.pb) - surfaced inline.
